sentences.en: PRESENTER: My guest on the show today is Alice Riches who started the Street Play Scheme where she lives in Beechwood Road.
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 今天节目邀请到的嘉宾是爱丽丝·里奇斯，她发起了自己所居住的桦木路（Beechwood Road）的“街头游乐计划”。

sentences.en: For those of you that don't already know Street Play involves local residents closing off their street for a few hours so that children have a chance to play in the street safely.
sentences.zh: 对于还不了解“街头游乐”概念的听众来说，它指的是当地居民将所在街道封闭数小时，以便孩子们能安全地在街上玩耍。

sentences.en: She started it in her own street, Beechwood Road, and the idea caught on, and there are now Street Play Schemes all over the city.
sentences.zh: 她首先在自己居住的桦木路发起该计划，这一理念迅速传播开来，如今本市各地均已设立街头游乐计划。

sentences.en: So when did you actually start the scheme, Alice?
sentences.zh: 那么，爱丽丝，您究竟是何时正式启动这项计划的呢？

sentences.en: ALICE: Well, I first had the idea when my oldest child was still a toddler, a so that's about six years ago now - but it took at least two years of campaigning before we were actually able to make it happen.
sentences.zh: ALICE: 嗯，我最初萌生这个想法时，我最大的孩子还只是个学步幼儿——也就是大约六年前；但真正付诸实践之前，我们至少花了两年时间进行倡导和推动。

sentences.en: So the scheme's been up and running for three years now.
sentences.zh: 因此，该计划目前已持续运行三年了。

sentences.en: We'd love to be able to close our road for longer - for the whole weekend, from Saturday morning until Sunday evening, for example.
sentences.zh: 我们非常希望能延长道路封闭时间——例如整个周末，从周六上午一直持续到周日晚上。

sentences.en: At the moment it's just once a week.
sentences.zh: 目前仅每周封闭一次。

sentences.en: But when we started it was only once a month.
sentences.zh: 而最初启动时，每月才封闭一次。

sentences.en: But we're working on it.
sentences.zh: 不过我们正在为此努力。

sentences.en: PRESENTER: So what actually happens when Beechwood Road is closed?
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 那么，当桦木路封闭时，具体会发生些什么呢？

sentences.en: ALICE: We have volunteer wardens, mostly parents but some elderly residents too, who block off our road at either end.
sentences.zh: ALICE: 我们有志愿者管理员，主要由家长担任，也有部分年长居民；他们分别在道路两端设置路障。

sentences.en: The council have provided special signs but there's always a volunteer there to explain what's happening to any motorists.
sentences.zh: 市议会提供了专用标识牌，但现场始终有志愿者向过往司机解释当前情况。

sentences.en: Generally, they're fine about it - we've only had to get the police involved once or twice.
sentences.zh: 通常司机们都表示理解——我们迄今仅需报警一两次。

sentences.en: Now I should explain that the road isn't completely closed to cars.
sentences.zh: 现在我要说明一点：这条道路并非完全禁止车辆通行。

sentences.en: But only residents' cars are allowed.
sentences.zh: 仅允许本街道居民的车辆驶入。

sentences.en: If people really need to get in or out of Beechwood Road, it's not a problem - as long as they drive at under 20 kilometres per hour.
sentences.zh: 如果有人确有需要进出桦木路，这完全不是问题——只要其车速保持在每小时20公里以内即可。

sentences.en: But most people just decide not to use their cars during this time, or they park in another street.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人在这一时段干脆选择不开车，或把车停到邻近街道。

sentences.en: The wardens are only there to stop through traffic.
sentences.zh: 管理员的职责仅限于阻止过境车辆通行。

sentences.en: PRESENTER: So can anyone apply to get involved in Street Play?
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 那么，是否任何人都可以申请参与街头游乐计划呢？

sentences.en: ALICE: Absolutely - we want to include all kids in the city - especially those who live on busy roads.
sentences.zh: ALICE: 当然可以——我们希望全市所有儿童都能参与其中，尤其是那些住在交通繁忙路段的孩子。

sentences.en: It's here that demand is greatest.
sentences.zh: 恰恰是在这些区域，需求最为迫切。

sentences.en: Obviously, there isn't such demand in wealthier areas where the children have access to parks or large gardens - or in the suburbs where there are usually more places for children to play outside.
sentences.zh: 显然，在较富裕地区，由于儿童可进入公园或拥有宽敞花园，或在郊区通常拥有更多户外活动场所，此类需求便不那么强烈。

sentences.en: I'd recommend that anyone listening who likes the idea should just give it a go.
sentences.zh: 我建议所有收听节目的、对此想法感兴趣的听众不妨亲自尝试一下。

sentences.en: We've been surprised by the positive reaction of residents all over the city.
sentences.zh: 我们对全市居民所表现出的积极反响感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And that's not just parents.
sentences.zh: 而且支持者不仅限于家长。

sentences.en: There are always a few who complain but they're : tiny minority.
sentences.zh: 当然总会有少数人抱怨，但他们只是极少数。

sentences.en: On the whole everyone is very supportive and say they're very happy to see children out on the street - even if it does get quite noisy.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，大家普遍非常支持，并表示十分乐见孩子们走上街头——哪怕现场难免会相当喧闹。

sentences.en: ALICE: There have been so many benefits of Street Play for the kids.
sentences.zh: ALICE: 街头游乐为孩子们带来了诸多益处。

sentences.en: Parents really like the fact that the kids are getting fresh air instead of sitting staring at a computer screen, even if they're not doing anything particularly energetic.
sentences.zh: 家长们尤其欣赏一点：孩子们得以呼吸新鲜空气，而非长时间呆坐凝视电脑屏幕，即便他们并未进行特别剧烈的活动。

sentences.en: And of course it's great that kids can play with their friends outside without being supervised by their parents but for me the biggest advantage is that kids develop confidence in themselves to / be outside without their parents.
sentences.zh: 当然，孩子们能在户外与朋友玩耍且无需父母全程看护，这一点也非常好；但对我而言，最大优势在于：孩子们由此建立起独自外出的信心，不再依赖父母陪伴。

sentences.en: The other really fantastic thing is that children get /018 to know the adults in the street - it's like having a big extended family.
sentences.zh: 另一项极为出色的好处是：孩子们得以认识街坊邻里中的成年人——仿佛拥有了一个庞大的扩展家庭。

sentences.en: PRESENTER: It certainly does have a lot of benefits. want to move on now and ask you about a related project in King Street.
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 这确实具备诸多益处。接下来我想转向另一个相关项目——国王街（King Street）的实践。

sentences.en: ALICE: Right.
sentences.zh: ALICE: 好的。

sentences.en: Well this was an experiment was involved in where local residents decided to try and reduce the traffic along King Street, which is the busiest main in road in our area, by persuading people not to use their cars for one day.
sentences.zh: 这是一项我们参与的实验：当地居民决定尝试减少国王街的车流量——该街是我们所在区域最繁忙的主干道——方法是劝说人们在某一天放弃驾车出行。

sentences.en: We thought about making people pay more for parking - but we decided that would be really unpopular so instead we just stopped people from parking on King Street but left the other car parks open.
sentences.zh: 我们曾考虑提高停车费——但判断此举将极不受欢迎，于是转而采取仅禁止在国王街停车、同时保留其他停车场开放的措施。

sentences.en: It was surprising how much of a difference all this made.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，这些举措产生了显著效果。

sentences.en: As we'd predicted, air quality was significantly better but what I hadn't expected was how much quieter 019/ it would be - even with the buses still running.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所预测，空气质量明显改善；但我未曾预料到的是环境安静程度的大幅提升——即便公交车仍在照常运行。

sentences.en: Of course everyone said they felt safer but we were actually amazed that sales in the shops went up considerably / that day - we thought there'd be fewer people out shopping - not more.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有人都表示感觉更安全了；而真正令我们惊讶的是，当天商铺销售额大幅上升——我们原本以为出门购物的人会减少，而非增多。

sentences.en: PRESENTER: That's really interesting so the fact that
sentences.zh: PRESENTER: 这确实非常有趣，因此事实是
